chips.label: Quiz
chips.title: This NPC asks you a quiz question

question.text: Which of the following is not a correct way to recover health?

segments.text: Which of the following is not a correct way to recover health?

choices.text: Use a potion, like a Red Potion

quiz.wrong_answer_heading: If you pick the wrong answer

wrong_answer_responses.text: If you see a chair or bench, you can sit on it! Just press the sit key when you're near one, and you'll notice that your recovery speed is faster than when you're just standing.

segments.text: If you see a chair or bench, you can sit on it! Just press the sit key when you're near one, and you'll notice that your recovery speed is faster than when you're just standing.

wrong_answer_responses.text: Using a potion lets you recover a large amount of HP all at once. It's truly an amazing item, isn't it?

segments.text: Using a potion lets you recover a large amount of HP all at once. It's truly an amazing item, isn't it?

wrong_answer_responses.text: When you're not in combat, just standing still will slowly restore your HP.

segments.text: When you're not in combat, just standing still will slowly restore your HP.

correct_answer_response.text: Yes, that's correct! There are so many ways to recover HP, right? Oh, and here's another tip! If you press the sit key on chairs around the map, you can sit and rest. Whenever you find a chair, try sitting on it. You'll recover faster than with just standing!

notes: Dialogue links item-db 270 ("Red Potion"), which is not otherwise part of this quest's data.

Quiz choices are listed in MeowDB document order, which is the in-game selection order (#L0, #L1, ...; quiz 6 leaks a raw "#L2" tag exactly at position 2). MeowDB renders the choice rows nested inside each other (a markup artifact); the extractor flattens them in document order. choices[].correct is MeowDB's marker: true = marked "Correct answer", false = rendered as an option and not marked, null = option reconstructed from unparsed game markup (raw_markup). Wrong-answer responses are listed in MeowDB order and are not linked to a specific choice by MeowDB.
gaps: MeowDB has no maximum level for quests (max_level is null).
MeowDB has no map-visit objectives or per-objective map restrictions for quests.
MeowDB does not say which "On completion" lines are shown before vs after the reward is given, or how dialogue pages are split into NPC chat windows.
